annotations.title: Get recorded conditions of a plan or product

description: Use this when: you need every recorded condition, pricing rule and source sentence of one plan or product found by search or named by the user. Do not use this when: you want to compare plans against a workload (use search or check_conditions). Get every recorded condition for one plan or product: value, which plans it applies to, exceptions, official source sentence, check date and purchase link. A product too long for one response comes with one source sentence per fact.

inputSchema.description: Give exactly one of offer_id or product_id.

name: get_details

evidence_detail.description: Present when the product was too long for one response: each fact carries one source sentence. Ask for a plan by offer_id for every sentence.

also_stated_in.description: get_details only: other official machine-readable documents of the provider (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, OpenAPI files, MCP tool listings) that contain the same quoted sentences.

applies_to.description: get_details only: billing options (billing) or search engines (search_engines) the fact is limited to.

derived.description: How the value follows from the quoted sentence when it is not literal.

quote.description: The sentence as it appears on that page.

retrieved_at.description: Date the page was read (YYYY-MM-DD). Only with detail=full.

url.description: Official page the sentence was found on.

exceptions.description: get_details only: plans with a different value.

level.description: Where the fact is recorded: offer (the plan), product or provider.

status.description: TRUE: stated with the value; FALSE / NOT_SUPPORTED: stated as unavailable; UNKNOWN: not stated; CONFLICT: official pages disagree (value lists each version); STALE: past its recheck date; MISSING: not recorded.

via_exception.description: Present and true when a plan-specific exception replaced the general value.

agent_access.description: The provider's machine channels as last checked: its official MCP server (whether it answered without credentials, how it asks for them, tool names), llms.txt and OpenAPI files. Only listing requests were made. null when not checked.

data_use_scope.description: Pages read, robots.txt results, the terms-of-use record and rights: the provider's rights state and whether this service serves it, and the rights of each source page.
